people.name: Richard Francis Gombrich
people.field: Indology and scholar of Sanskrit, Pāli, and Buddhist studies

relations.subject: Richard Francis Gombrich
relations.evidence: Gombrich is the only child of classical pianist Ilse Gombrich (née Heller; 1910–2006), and Austrian-British art historian Sir Ernst Gombrich.

relations.subject: Richard Francis Gombrich
relations.evidence: before attending Magdalen College, Oxford, in 1957.

relations.subject: Richard Francis Gombrich
relations.evidence: He received his M.A. from Harvard University in 1963.

relations.subject: Richard Francis Gombrich
relations.evidence: and his DPhil from the same university in 1970. His doctoral thesis was entitled Contemporary Sinhalese Buddhism in its relation to the Pali canon.

relations.subject: Richard Francis Gombrich
relations.evidence: He was the Boden Professor of Sanskrit at the University of Oxford from 1976 to 2004.

relations.subject: Richard Francis Gombrich
relations.evidence: Boden Professor of Sanskrit (and fellow of Balliol College), University of Oxford (1976–2004)

relations.subject: Richard Francis Gombrich
relations.evidence: He is a past president of the Pali Text Society (1994–2002)

relations.subject: Richard Francis Gombrich
relations.evidence: On taking mandatory retirement in 2004 he founded the Oxford Centre for Buddhist Studies

relations.subject: Richard Francis Gombrich
relations.evidence: He was general editor of the Clay Sanskrit Library from its founding until February 2008.
